title: BTL! Tooltips Enhanced
description: Improves the Tooltips for Better Than Legacy!
body:
## Note
This is meant for Better Than Adventure! A *heavily* modified version of Beta 1.7.3.
## Info
This is meant to replace the default tooltips from Better Than Legacy! to be improved and more like Legacy Console Edition (or Legacy4J)
## Requirements
This requires [Better Than Adventure!](https://www.betterthanadventure.net/) (Babric) and [Better Than Legacy!](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-than-legacy) for this texture pack to work.
